name: mrh-p6
description: Talk to your Primavera P6 Professional SQLite schedules.
long_description: Open a Primavera P6 Professional SQLite database and ask about it in plain language: project overview, activity search and details, a 15-check schedule health score, baseline slips, look-ahead, read-only SQL and XER export. With editing enabled: update, create and delete activities, manage relationships, set the data date and undo, with an automatic backup before the first edit.

tools.name: mrh_db_find
tools.description: List P6 SQLite (.db/.sqlite) files in a folder

tools.name: mrh_db_open
tools.description: Open a Primavera P6 Professional SQLite database by full path

tools.name: mrh_project_list
tools.description: List the projects in the open database with data date, finish, baseline project and activity count.

tools.name: mrh_project_overview
tools.description: Progress (duration weighted), planned progress from the baseline, forecast vs baseline finish, status counts, critical/negative-float counts and progress per top-level WBS.

tools.name: mrh_activity_search
tools.description: Filter and list activities

tools.name: mrh_activity_get
tools.description: Full details of one activity: dates, durations, float, constraints, predecessors and successors, resource assignments, activity codes, user fields and notes.

tools.name: mrh_health_check
tools.description: Run 15 schedule quality checks (missing logic, leads, lags, non-FS links, hard constraints, high/negative float, long durations, invalid dates, status errors, duplicate links, loops, redundant links, critical activities) and return a 0-100 score with sample activity codes per check.

tools.name: mrh_baseline_compare
tools.description: Activities whose current finish is later than the baseline finish, worst first.

tools.name: mrh_lookahead
tools.description: Activities that start or finish within N days after the data date.

tools.name: mrh_sql_read
tools.description: Run one read-only SELECT/WITH query on the P6 database (P6 table names such as TASK, TASKPRED, PROJWBS, CALENDAR, RSRC, TASKRSRC)

tools.name: mrh_xer_export
tools.description: Write a project to an XER file (the database is not changed)

tools.name: mrh_backup_list
tools.description: List the automatic backups of the open database (taken before edits, kept next to the database in mrh_yedekler).

tools.name: mrh_activity_update
tools.description: Apply the same changes to one or many activities in ONE transaction (all or nothing)

tools.name: mrh_activity_create
tools.description: Create a not-started activity (code is generated when omitted)

tools.name: mrh_activity_delete
tools.description: Delete activities together with their links, resource assignments, codes, user field values and notes

tools.name: mrh_link_add
tools.description: Add a relationship between two activities

tools.name: mrh_link_update
tools.description: Change the type and/or lag of a relationship (link_id from mrh_activity_get).

tools.name: mrh_link_delete
tools.description: Delete relationships by link_id (from mrh_activity_get).

tools.name: mrh_data_date_set
tools.description: Set the project data date (YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: mrh_undo
tools.description: Revert the last edit made in this session

database.title: P6 database file
database.description: Optional. The P6 SQLite (.db) file to open automatically.

allow_edit.title: Allow editing
allow_edit.description: Off = read-only. Turn the extension off and on after changing.
